questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The correct statement regarding a soap solution in water at a low concentration is
options: The anions of the soap molecules are present in the bulk of the solution with their ionic ends as well as tails in water.
The anions of the soap molecules are present at the surface of the solution with their ionic ends as well as tails staying away from the water.
The anions of the soap molecules are present at the surface of the solution with their ionic ends in water and tails staying away from the water.
The anions of the soap molecules are present at the surface of the solution with their tails in water and ionic ends staying away from the water.
